text:
maya: Heads-up — we saw a few 8xA100 jobs in eu-west-2 degrade to NCCL-over-TCP and throughput dropped ~6x this morning. starts at 04:12 UTC
sam: saw alerts too, infra-bot posted RDMA-error spikes :eyes:
infra-bot: [ALERT] rdma_rx_errors > baseline on eu-west-2-rack-14 (04:13)
maya: logs show errno 22 on ibverbs send completion, and kernel dmesg has "UDP checksum failed" coming from mlx5_core
irene: UDP checksum fail for RoCE v2 usually means offload/encap mismatch or a middlebox rewriting headers. any pcap?
maya: captured udp dump on host:
```
04:12:34.123456 IP 10.0.14.21.4420 > 10.0.14.29.4420: UDP, length 120
... checksum 0x0000 BAD
```
sam: interesting — our new cloud-router image rolled yesterday, it has ECN/DSCP rewrite for telemetry
nora: do ToRs do any DSCP/ECN rewriting? they should not touch UDP payload but some smart NICs/routers re-calc headers and can break offload
maya: verified: tcpdump on host sees packet with checksum bad, but a span capture on the switch port shows checksum good. implies a device between host and switch rewrote the IP header and the NIC's hardware offload state is now inconsistent
irene: that will make the NIC drop packets once it validates offloads. quick workaround: disable UDP checksum offloading on affected hosts:
```
ethtool -K eth0 tx-checksum-ipv4 off tx-checksum-udp off tso off gso off gro off
# or: ethtool -K eth0 txudp_tnl-segmentation off
```
maya: disabled offload on the three hosts running the failing jobs and NCCL fell back to RoCE correctly, job throughput back to expected :thumbsup:
sam: root cause looks like cloud-router v2.3 DSCP/ECN rewrite not recalculating UDP checksum for encapsulated RoCEv2 flows. filed bug CR-3421 and pinned rollout
nora: remediation plan: 1) rollback router v2.3 in eu-west-2 2) patch router to recalc checksums or add explicit bypass for UDP dport 4420/ibverbs 3) add preflight checks that run a short RDMA smoke test after infra changes
irene: also adding a kernel metric and alert for "udp_checksum_bad" and an nsenter-level check for checksum mismatch on uplinks so we catch this before jobs get scheduled
maya: thanks. I'll coordinate rollback and postmortem doc. leaving this thread open until revert complete. :white_check_mark:
